Exosome Hair Treatment

Worried about hair fall, a widening part or a thinning hairline? Exosome hair treatment delivers powerful growth signals straight to your follicles, helping slow hair fall, wake up weak roots and grow thicker hair. No blood draw, little downtime, and a plan built around the cause of your hair loss.

Treatment overview

What is Exosome Hair Treatment?

Exosomes are tiny bubbles that cells release to send messages. They're packed with growth factors, proteins and other signals. When they reach your hair follicles, they tell them to repair, calm down inflammation and get back into the growing phase.

Hair loss often happens when follicles get stuck in the resting phase or slowly shrink. Exosome treatment tops up the signals they need to grow, so weak, thin hairs can grow back stronger and fuller over a few months.

Read more: the hair growth cycle

Every hair goes through three phases:

  • Growing (anagen): lasts 2 to 7 years. The longer it lasts, the longer and thicker your hair.
  • Transition (catagen): a short 2 to 3 week phase when growth stops.
  • Resting and shedding (telogen): about 3 months, after which the hair falls out and a new one starts.

Stress, hormones, illness, poor nutrition and genetics can push more hairs into the resting phase, or make each new hair thinner. Exosomes help move follicles back into growth. Read more about the causes of hair loss.

1. DeliverDermapen makes tiny channels so exosomes reach the follicles.
2. SignalGrowth signals wake up weak, resting follicles.
3. RegrowFollicles grow thicker hair over the next few months.

What to expect

Benefits of Exosome Hair Treatment

Exosomes tackle hair loss at the root, literally.

Less Hair Fall

Strengthens weak roots so fewer hairs come out in the shower and on your pillow.

New Hair Growth

Wakes up sleeping follicles and pushes them back into the growth phase.

Thicker, Denser Hair

Thin strands grow back stronger, so hair looks fuller and covers the scalp better.

Healthier Follicles

Growth signals help follicles repair and stay in the growing phase for longer.

Healthier Scalp

Calms inflammation and improves blood flow, giving roots a better place to grow.

Little Downtime

Mild redness for a day at most. You can go back to work the same day.

No Blood Draw

Unlike PRP, the exosomes are ready-made, so there's no blood sample needed.

Results That Build

Improvements keep building for months as more follicles return to growth.

Excessive hair fall

Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal. If you're seeing clumps in the shower, on your pillow or in your comb, something has pushed your follicles into resting too early. Exosomes help calm the scalp and push follicles back into the growing phase.

  • Slows daily hair fall
  • Stronger roots
  • Often noticeable within 1 to 2 months

What Stage Is Your Hair Loss?

Exosomes work best on follicles that are still alive. The earlier you start, the better your results.

Early thinning

More hair fall, a slightly wider part or a softer hairline. The best time to start.

Best for: hair fall, early thinning
Downtime: none to 1 day
Sessions: 4, every 3–4 weeks

Moderate thinning

Visible scalp through the hair, thinning crown or temples. Still very treatable.

Best for: pattern thinning, crown
Downtime: none to 1 day
Sessions: 6, plus maintenance

Advanced / bald areas

Smooth, shiny areas where follicles have stopped. Exosomes can't regrow these.

Best for: support around bald areas
Downtime: none to 1 day
Sessions: we'll discuss transplant options honestly

Exosomes Work Best as Part of a Plan

Hair loss usually has more than one cause. That's why our doctors look at the full picture, not just the scalp.

Before we treat, we find out why your hair is falling. Our doctors examine your scalp and may suggest simple blood tests.

  • Thyroid function
  • Hormones and PCOS checks for women

Tip: never start or stop hair medicines without your doctor

Your appointment

Exosome Hair Treatment Procedure

A proper diagnosis comes first.

  • Your doctor examines your scalp and hair pattern and takes progress photos.
  • Blood tests may be suggested to check iron, vitamins, thyroid or hormones.
  • Avoid blood thinners and anti-inflammatory painkillers for a few days, if your doctor agrees.
  • Eat a light meal and drink plenty of water.
  • Come with a clean, dry scalp, with no oils, gels or sprays.

A session takes 45 to 60 minutes.

  • Your scalp is cleaned and disinfected.
  • Numbing cream may be applied for comfort.
  • The Dermapen makes tiny channels across the thinning areas.
  • The exosome solution is applied and massaged in.
  • You may feel mild prickling, but most people find it easy.

You can go straight back to your day. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Mild redness or tenderness for a day or two.
  • Don't wash your hair for 24 hours.
  • Avoid gym, swimming and direct sun on the scalp for 48 hours.
  • Skip hair colour, straightening and harsh styling for a week.
  • Book your next session in 3 to 4 weeks.

Results

Exosome Hair Treatment Results Timeline

Hair grows slowly, so results build over months. Here's what most people notice.

  1. Weeks 2–8

    Less hair fall

    Fewer hairs in the shower, on your pillow and in your comb.

  2. Months 2–3

    Baby hairs

    Short new hairs appear along the hairline and parting.

  3. Months 4–6

    Thicker hair

    Strands are stronger and hair looks fuller, with less scalp showing.

  4. After the course

    Maintain

    A session every 3 to 6 months and home care keep results going.

Illustrative model images. Results vary with the cause and stage of hair loss.

A good fit if you

  • Have more hair fall than usual
  • Notice early thinning or a wider part
  • Have a receding hairline that's still covered
  • Want a treatment with no blood draw

Not ideal if you

  • Have fully bald, shiny areas
  • Have an active scalp infection
  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Expect results in a few weeks

Aftercare

Hair Treatment Aftercare

A few simple steps help the exosomes work and protect your scalp.

Do

  • Leave your scalp alone so exosomes absorb
  • Sleep on a clean pillowcase
  • Drink plenty of water
  • Wear a loose cap if you go out in the sun

Avoid

  • Washing your hair
  • Oils, gels, sprays or serums
  • Touching or scratching the scalp
  • Helmets and tight caps if you can

Do

  • Wash with a mild shampoo and lukewarm water
  • Pat hair dry gently
  • Restart prescribed home treatment when advised
  • Eat protein-rich meals

Avoid

  • Gym, swimming and saunas for 48 hours
  • Hair colour, bleach or straightening for a week
  • Very hot hair dryers and tight hairstyles
  • Hair oil massages for 3 days

Healthy habits

  • Protein, iron and vitamin-rich food
  • 7 to 8 hours of sleep
  • Manage stress
  • Gentle, wide-tooth combing

Keep up

  • Prescribed home treatment
  • Scalp-friendly shampoo
  • Progress check every few months
  • Maintenance sessions

Myths vs facts

Hair Loss Myths, Busted

"Oiling every day stops hair fall."
Oiling can soften hair and scalp, but it doesn't fix the hormonal, nutritional or genetic causes of hair loss. Too much oil can even worsen dandruff.
"Hair loss only happens to older men."
Many people start thinning in their 20s, and women experience hair loss too, often linked to hormones, iron or thyroid.
"Cutting hair makes it grow thicker."
Trimming removes split ends but doesn't change how many hairs grow from your scalp or how thick they are.
"Once it's gone, nothing can help."
Weak, thinning hair can often be revived. Only fully bald areas, where follicles are gone, usually need a hair transplant.
"Treatments work in a few weeks."
Hair grows about 1 cm a month. Real changes take 3 to 6 months, so consistency matters.

Safety first

Side Effects and Who Should Wait

Exosome hair treatment is well tolerated. Here's what's normal and when to check with your doctor first.

Common and temporary

  • Mild redness or tenderness for a day or two
  • Tiny pinpoint marks on the scalp
  • Slight itching as the scalp heals
  • A brief increase in shedding as new hairs push out old ones (uncommon)

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have a scalp infection, open wound or active psoriasis
  • Have a history of cancer
  • Have an autoimmune condition or take immune-suppressing medicines
  • Have a bleeding disorder or take blood thinners

Questions

Exosome Hair Treatment FAQs

What are exosomes for hair?
Exosomes are tiny messengers that cells use to talk to each other. They carry growth factors and proteins. On the scalp, they signal hair follicles to repair, stay in the growing phase and produce thicker hair.
How is exosome hair treatment done?
At Facelit, we use Dermapen microneedling to make tiny channels in the scalp, then apply the exosome solution so it reaches the follicles. A session takes 45 to 60 minutes.
Is exosome hair treatment painful?
Most people feel only mild prickling. We apply a numbing cream first if needed, and there's no blood draw like PRP.
How many sessions will I need?
Most people do 4 to 6 sessions, 3 to 4 weeks apart, then a maintenance session every 3 to 6 months.
When will I see results?
Hair fall often slows within 4 to 8 weeks. New baby hairs usually appear around 2 to 3 months, and better thickness and density show by 4 to 6 months.
Exosomes vs PRP for hair: which is better?
Both use growth signals. PRP comes from your own blood, so its strength varies from person to person. Exosomes are a ready-made, more concentrated product with no blood draw. Many people get great results combining them.
Can exosomes regrow hair on a bald patch?
Exosomes work on follicles that are still alive, even if weak. Smooth, shiny bald areas where follicles have gone usually can't regrow with any injectable. We'll tell you honestly and discuss options like hair transplant.
Is it suitable for women?
Yes. Exosomes work well for female pattern thinning, postpartum shedding and stress-related hair fall. We also check iron, thyroid and hormones to treat the root cause.
Are the results permanent?
They last as long as the cause of hair loss is managed. Pattern hair loss is ongoing, so most people need maintenance sessions and home care to keep their results.
Can I wash my hair after treatment?
Wait at least 24 hours before washing so the exosomes can absorb fully. Then use a mild shampoo.
Are there any side effects?
Mild redness, tenderness or tiny pinpoint marks on the scalp for a day or two. Serious side effects are rare when done by doctors with quality products.
Where can I get exosome hair treatment in Kerala?
Facelit offers exosome hair treatment in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
How much does exosome hair treatment cost?
It depends on the area and the number of sessions. The 4-session package offers better value. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
